column1: According to conservationists, populations of around two thirds of butterfly species have declined in Britain over the past 40 years.
column2: 据自然保护工作者介绍，在过去40年里，英国大约三分之二的蝴蝶物种种群数量有所下降。

column1: If this trend continues, it might have unpredictable knock-on effects for other species in the ecosystem.
column2: 如果这一趋势继续下去，生态系统中的其他物种可能会受到难以预料的连锁影响。

column1: Butterfly eggs develop into caterpillars and these insects, which are the second stage in a new butterfly’s lifecycle, consume vast quantities of plant material, and in turn act as prey for birds as well as bats and other small mammals.
column2: 蝴蝶卵发育成毛毛虫。毛毛虫处在蝴蝶生命周期的第二阶段，要吃掉大量植物，而它们自己又是鸟类、蝙蝠和其他小型哺乳动物的猎物。

column1: Only by arming themselves with an understanding of why butterfly numbers are down can conservationists hope to halt or reverse the decline.
column2: 自然保护工作者只有弄清蝴蝶数量为什么会减少，才有希望遏止甚至扭转这种下降趋势。

column1: Butterflies prefer outdoor conditions to be ‘just right’, which means neither too hot nor too cold.
column2: 蝴蝶喜欢“恰到好处”的户外环境，也就是说，既不能太热，也不能太冷。
column6: neither too hot nor too cold|既不过热，也不过冷

column1: Under the conditions of climate change, the temperature at any given time in summer is generally getting warmer, leaving butterflies with the challenge of how to deal with this.
column2: 在气候变化的背景下，夏季任一时段的气温总体上都在升高，蝴蝶面临的挑战便是如何应对这种变化。
column4: at any given time|在任一特定时段

column1: One of the main ways in which species are ensuring conditions suit them is by changing the time of year at which they are active and reproduce.
column2: 为了使环境条件适合自身，各物种采取的主要方式之一，就是改变一年中活动和繁殖的时间。
column4: conditions suit them|条件适合它们
column5: time of year|一年中的时段

column1: Scientists refer to the timing of such lifecycle events as ‘phenology’, so when an animal or plant starts to do something earlier in the year than it usually does, it is said to be ‘advancing its phenology’.
column2: 科学家把这些生命活动发生的时节称为“物候”。如果一种动物或植物开始某项活动的时间比往年更早，就称为“物候提前”。
column5: lifecycle events|生命周期中的活动
column7: earlier in the year|在一年中更早的时候

column1: These advances have been observed already in a wide range of butterflies — indeed, most species are advancing their phenology to some extent.
column2: 许多不同的蝴蝶都已经出现了这种提前现象。事实上，大多数物种的物候都在一定程度上有所提前。
column5: a wide range of|多种多样的
column8: to some extent|在一定程度上

column1: In Britain, as the average spring temperature has increased by roughly 0.5 °C over the past 20 years, species have advanced by between three days and a week on average, to keep in line with cooler temperatures.
column2: 过去20年里，英国春季平均气温上升了约0.5摄氏度。为了仍能遇上较凉爽的气温，不同蝴蝶物种的物候平均提前了三天到一周。
column3: average spring temperature|春季平均气温
column7: between three days and a week|三天到一周
column9: keep in line with|与……保持一致

column1: Is this a sign that butterflies are well equipped to cope with climate change, and readily adjust to new temperatures?
column2: 这是否说明蝴蝶具备足够的能力应对气候变化，能轻松适应新的气温呢？
column4: well equipped to|具备充分条件做……

column1: Or are these populations under stress, being dragged along unwillingly by unnaturally fast changes?
column2: 还是说，这些种群其实正承受着压力，被异常迅速的变化推着走，身不由己？

column1: The answer is still unknown, but a new study is seeking to answer these questions.
column2: 答案仍不清楚，但一项新研究正试图回答这些问题。

column1: First, the researchers pulled together data from millions of records that had been submitted by butterfly enthusiasts — people who spend their free time observing the activities of different species.
column2: 研究人员先把蝴蝶爱好者提交的数百万条观察记录汇集起来。这些爱好者用空闲时间观察不同物种的活动。
column4: millions of records|数百万条记录

column1: This provided information on 130 species of butterflies in Great Britain every year for a 20-year period.
column2: 这些记录提供了大不列颠岛上130种蝴蝶在连续20年里逐年的资料。

column1: They then estimated the abundance and distribution of each species across this time, along with how far north in the country they had moved.
column2: 接着，他们估算了这段时期各物种的数量和分布情况，以及它们在英国境内向北移动了多远。
column6: across this time|在这段时期内
column8: how far north|向北移动的距离

column1: The data also, crucially, allowed researchers to estimate subtle changes in what time of the year each species was changing into an adult butterfly.
column2: 关键的是，这些数据还能让研究人员估算各物种在一年中何时羽化为成蝶，以及这个时间发生了哪些细微的变化。
column6: what time of the year|一年中的什么时候

column1: Analysing the trends in each variable, the researchers discovered that species with more flexible lifecycles were more likely to be able to benefit from an earlier emergence driven by climate change.
column2: 研究人员分析各变量的变化趋势后发现，生命周期更灵活的物种，更有可能从气候变化引起的提前羽化中获益。

column1: Some species are able to go from caterpillar to butterfly twice or more per year, so that the individual butterflies you see flying in the spring are the grandchildren or great-grandchildren of the individuals seen a year previously.
column2: 在有些物种中，从毛毛虫发育成蝴蝶的过程每年能发生两次或更多次。因此，你今年春天看见飞舞的蝴蝶，已经是去年春天所见蝴蝶的孙辈或曾孙辈了。
column4: twice or more per year|每年两次或更多

column1: Among these species, researchers observed that those which have been advancing their phenology the most over the 20-year study period also had the most positive trends in abundance, distribution and northwards extent.
column2: 研究人员观察到，在这些蝴蝶当中，20年研究期间物候提前得最多的物种，在种群数量、分布情况和分布区向北延伸程度上也呈现出最有利的变化趋势。
column9: northwards extent|分布区向北延伸的程度

column1: For these species, such as Britain’s tiniest butterfly, the dainty Small Blue, whose colonies are up to a hundred strong, some develop into butterflies early in spring, allowing their summer generations to complete another reproductive cycle by autumn so that more population growth occurs.
column2: 英国最小的蝴蝶枯灰蝶便是其中一例。它体态小巧，一个群体多可达一百只。有些个体在早春便发育成成蝶，这使夏季的一代能在秋季到来之前再完成一轮繁殖，从而推动种群数量进一步增长。
column7: up to a hundred strong|数量多达一百只

column1: Other species, however, are less flexible and restricted to a single reproductive cycle per year.
column2: 不过，另一些物种的变通余地较小，每年只能完成一个繁殖周期。

column1: For these species, there was no evidence of any benefit to emerging earlier.
column2: 对这些物种而言，没有证据表明提前羽化有任何好处。

column1: Indeed, worryingly, it was found that the species in this group that specialise in very specific habitat types, often related to the caterpillar’s preferred diet, actually tended to be most at harm from advancing phenology.
column2: 事实上，研究还有一个令人担忧的发现：这组蝴蝶中，有些物种只能适应非常特定的生境，这通常和毛毛虫偏好的食物有关。恰恰是这些物种往往最容易因物候提前而受到伤害。

column1: The beautiful High Brown Fritillary, often described as Britain’s most endangered butterfly, is in this group.
column2: 美丽的灿福豹蛱蝶就属于这一组，人们常把它称为英国最濒危的蝴蝶。
column3: High Brown Fritillary|n. 灿福豹蛱蝶

column1: It is found only in coppiced woodland and limestone pavement habitats.
column2: 它只分布于经过萌芽更新的矮林以及石灰岩铺面这两类生境。
column4: coppiced woodland|经砍伐后萌芽更新的矮林

column1: It is also a single-generation butterfly that has advanced its phenology.
column2: 它也是一种一年只有一代、物候已有所提前的蝴蝶。

column1: This suggests that climate change, while undoubtedly not the sole cause, might have played a part in the downfall of this species.
column2: 这说明，气候变化虽然肯定不是唯一的原因，却可能在这个物种的衰落中起了一定作用。
column6: might have played a part|可能起过作用

column1: All is not lost, however.
column2: 不过，事情并非毫无希望。
column3: All is not lost|还没有失去一切希望

column1: Many of Britain’s single-generation species show the capacity, in continental Europe, to add a second generation in years that are sufficiently warm.
column2: 许多在英国一年只繁殖一代的物种，在欧洲大陆却显示出另一种能力：遇上足够暖和的年份，它们可以再繁殖一代。

column1: Therefore, as the climate continues to warm, species like the Silver-studded Blue might be able to switch to multiple generations in the UK as well, and so begin to extract benefits from the additional warmth, potentially leading to population increases.
column2: 因此，随着气候持续变暖，豆灰蝶等物种在英国也有可能转为一年繁殖多代，从而开始从升温中获益，种群数量也可能随之增加。

column1: More immediately, conservationists can arm themselves with all this knowledge to spot the warning signs of species that may be at risk.
column2: 更直接地说，保护工作者可以利用这些知识，识别哪些物种可能正面临危险的预警信号。

column1: The White Admiral of southern England, a much sought-after butterfly, experienced a significant increase in numbers from the 1920s but has shown a considerable decline in the past 20 years.
column2: 英格兰南部的隐线蛱蝶很受蝴蝶爱好者追捧。它的数量自20世纪20年代起曾大幅增加，但近20年来却显著下降。
column8: in the past 20 years|在过去20年里

column1: This may be because the caterpillar exists solely on a diet of a plant called honeysuckle.
column2: 这可能是因为它的毛毛虫只吃一种叫作忍冬的植物。

column1: But it is also likely to be due to climate change.
column2: 但这也很可能与气候变化有关。
